description: What an amount due in the future is worth today at a fixed yearly discount rate, and the discount between the two (PV = FV / (1 + r/n)^(n x t)). Use for questions about the value today of money received later, at a discount rate the user supplies. Do not use to pick a discount rate (the tool has none of its own), for several payments over time, or for a market price: it discounts one amount at one fixed rate. For growth going forward use smartfin_calculate_future_value.

annual_rate_pct.description: Yearly discount rate in %, above -100, e.g. 6

compounding_frequency.description: Times a year the rate compounds: 1 annually, 2 semiannually, 4 quarterly, 12 monthly, 52 weekly, 365 daily

currency.description: Currency symbol for the amounts in the summary only; amounts are never converted. The link opens the page in US dollars, and how_to says to pick the currency there. Default USD

future_value.description: Amount due later, in the currency chosen

years.description: Years until the amount is due; a part of a year is a decimal

name: smartfin_calculate_present_value

how_to.description: Steps for the user to see or redo this on smartfin.fyi

embed.description: Free embed code for this calculator, for a site the user runs

page.description: SmartFin's page for this stock, when it has one

smartfin.description: Open and adjust this result on smartfin.fyi

summary.description: Plain-language result the assistant can quote

title: Present value of a future amount
